question: According to Frontex, 330 000 illegal immigrants were detected whilst crossing borders in 2022 . In 2023, the number of illegal immigrants was 380 000. According to Eurostat, there were 1.08 million illegal immigrants present on EU territory.

Given the high number of asylum seekers in recent years (1 million per year) and the low recognition rate (50% not entitled to protection), there should be a sharp increase in the number of illegal immigrants on European territory. The return rate was only 20 % in the last two years. Thus, 80 % did not comply with the order to go back.

Frontex assisted in 24 850 return operations in 2022, of which only 40 % were voluntary. What is the Commission’s assessment of the rate of return of only 1 in 5, given that there are 1 million new asylum seekers per year?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (8.7.2024) In 2023, the number of effective returns increased from 72 400 to 91 465 (+26%) and the return rate increased from 16% to 19% compared to the previous year.

Frontex has become an essential actor in the common EU system for return, taking on new responsibilities and tools related to return of people who have no right to stay in the EU, and has made an important progress in enhancing the support in the area of return and reintegration.

The Pact on Migration and Asylum1, the EU strategy on voluntary return and reintegration2 and the operational strategy of the Return Coordinator3 all call for making full use of the potential of digital systems for more efficient procedures in the field of return, readmission and reintegration.

With the entry into force of the new legislation, the Commission is taking stock of the current challenges and is reflecting on future ideas on how to ensure a coherent and uniform EU-wide approach to digital systems, key enablers for more effective procedures and cooperation and for reliable data-collection, both crucial to effectively monitor return policy and ultimately contribute towards expediting return procedures and create a closer link between the asylum and the return process.
1 COM(2020) 609 final. 2 COM(2021) 120 final. 3 COM(2023) 45 final.
